Official Colorado Buffaloes Shop: CU Buffs Sports Gear & Apparel

Find the best selection of officially Licensed CU Buffs apparel and merchandise at the Colorado Buffaloes Athletics Store, including including Colorado Coach Prime gear. Train like your favorite CU athletes when you shop Colorado Nike Pegasus shoes, or grab a Colorado Buffaloes hoodie as well. We have a full assortment of officially licensed University of Colorado apparel and merchandise for Buffaloes fans of all ages. The CU Buffaloes Athletics Store carries official University of Colorado football Gear including Colorado Buffaloes Gifts. Gear yourself up for game time in the newest Officially Licensed Buffaloes Apparel from Nike and the most popular brands in sports apparel.

Colorado Buffaloes Football Gear

Show your Colorado Buffaloes pride with the latest official CU Buffs football gear from the Official Colorado Buffaloes Online Shop. Visit the CU Buffs Shop for the latest Nike collection: official Colorado polos, official Colorado jerseys, and Nike sideline jackets designed for the team. Rep your favorite stars with Nike Alumni Jerseys, with a Shedeur Sanders Colorado jersey or a Travis Hunter Colorado jersey—must-haves for any true Buffs fan. Whether you're looking for a new Colorado Buffaloes jersey to wear to the next game, a comfortable t-shirt to represent your team on game day, or a stylish hoodie for the colder months, we have something for every fan. Explore our collection of Colorado Buffaloes football apparel and find the perfect way to support your team.

Colorado Buffaloes Basketball Jerseys & Apparel

Get ready to support your Buffs with the latest Colorado Buffaloes basketball gear from the Official Colorado Buffaloes Shop. Our selection of Buffs Basketball jerseys, t-shirts, and more has everything you need to back the team, whether you're on campus or cheering from afar. Find officially licensed Colorado Buffaloes Basketball apparel that's perfect for showing your black and gold pride. From game day to everyday wear, we've got you covered with the best Buffs Basketball jerseys and Colorado Buffaloes t-shirts available. Don't wait—gear up and represent the Buffs in style today.
